title: C-79: keep the real client at the login prompt for five minutes while keepalives pass both ways
notes: The client accepts a session only after a login attempt, so submit the run's deliberately wrong password and leave its retry prompt untouched.
Six server keepalive exchanges are scheduled at 60-second intervals; waiting for six after the retry prompt proves at least five minutes idle there.
Each interval also waits for a client-to-server keepalive; the session-close check runs before the driver shuts the client down.
